scope: Review of sales continuation confirmation and idempotent push registration fixes, including competing unsubscribe requests

findings.title: Concurrent ownership transfer and unsubscribe acquire locks in opposite order
findings.trigger: An old account unsubscribes while another account registers the same device endpoint, with a pending delivery for the old account.
findings.evidence: subscribe line 34 updates subculture_push_delivery before line 35 upserts subculture_push_subscription. unsubscribe line 37 updates subculture_push_subscription before subculture_push_delivery. Only subscribe obtains the endpoint advisory lock at line 33.
findings.impact: Concurrent requests deadlock and PostgreSQL aborts one transaction with 40P01. ApiExceptionHandler maps it to 409 without retry; browser disablePush unsubscribes even if the DELETE fails.
findings.reproduction: ReviewPushConcurrency.java calls the actual service methods on two connections with barriers between existing statements: TRANSFER=SUCCESS; UNSUBSCRIBE=SQLSTATE=40P01.
findings.recommendation: Use the same endpoint advisory lock for subscribe and unsubscribe and maintain a consistent subscription/delivery lock order; add a concurrent regression test.

validation.fixtures: Fixtures temporarily committed for cross-connection visibility, concurrent service transactions rolled back, exact fixture IDs removed in finally
